senses.gloss: m. pl. (Κόρτιοι, Polybius 5, 52, 5; Strabo XI, 13) natives of Ḳartu (mountaineers of Media).
units: Yeb. 16ᵃ ק׳ איתמר וכ׳ the traditional spelling is Ḳartuyim (and not Ḳarduyim), as people say, disqualified Kartuenians.

<cite ref="Yevamot 16a:16">Ib.</cite> (Chald. form) <he>קַרְתּוּיֵי וכ׳</he> Kartuenians are not the same as Ḳarduenians, as people say <he>ק׳ פסילי</he>; v. <cite ref="S01905"><he>קרְדּוּיִים</he></cite>.
